SELECT SEC_INFO.SEC_ID secId, SEC_INFO.BOND_NAME bondName, SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION bondAbbreviation, SEC_INFO.TRADING_PLACES tradingPlaces, SEC_INFO.REGISTERED_CUSTODIAN registeredCustodian, SEC_INFO.ISSUER, SEC_INFO.RAISE_MODE raiseMode, SEC_INFO.DOMESTIC_AND_FOREIGN domesticAndForeign, SEC_INFO.IS_BONDS_WITH_RIGHTS isBondsWithRights, SEC_INFO.TRADING_CALENDAR tradingCalendar, SEC_INFO.SPECIAL_TERMS specialTerms, RELEASE_INFO.RELEASE_TYPE releaseType, RDI_RELEASE_INFO.FACE_VALUE faceValue, RDI_RELEASE_INFO.DAY_COUNT dayCount,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_METHOD,RELEASE_INFO.ISSUING_METHOD) as issueMethod,
RELEASE_INFO.BIDDING_METHOD as biddingMethod, RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_TARGET as tenderTarget, RELEASE_INFO.ADDITIONAL_BATCHES as additionalBatches,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE * 100000000, ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE, 2)) as issueSize, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) as issueDate, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.PAYMENT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) as eventDate, RELEASE_INFO.DEBT_REGISTRATION_DATE AS debtRegistrationDate,
RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_DATE AS listingDate, RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_CODE AS listingCode, SEC_INFO.CROSS_MARKET_CODE AS crossMarketCode,
nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) as interestAccrualDate,
SEC_INFO.VALUE_DATE valueDate, SEC_INFO.EXPIRY_DATE expiryDate, SEC_INFO.PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION primaryClassification, SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION secondaryClassification, SEC_INFO.VARIETY_OF_COUPONS varietyOfCoupons, SEC_INFO.INTEREST_PAYMENT_FREQUENCY interestPaymentFrequency, SEC_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, SEC_INFO.CURRENCY,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX) as issuePx, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.STIPULATION_VALUE, RELEASE_INFO.STIPULATION_VALUE) as stipulationValue,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MIN_SUB_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT) as singleMinSubAmt, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT) as singleMaxSubAmt,
RDI_RELEASE_INFO.REMARK AS remark,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE, RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE) as couponRate, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME, RELEASE_INFO.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME) as benchmarkCurveName, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.DECIMAL_PLACES, RELEASE_INFO.DECIMAL_PLACES) as decimalPlaces, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SPREAD, RELEASE_INFO.SPREAD) as spread,
RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_START_TIME AS issueStartTime, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_END_TIME AS issueEndTime, RELEASE_INFO.BID_DATE as bidDate, RELEASE_INFO.ADDITIONAL_TENDER_DATE as additionalTenderDate,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_SUB_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_SUB_AMT) as maxSubAmt, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT) as minPerTenderAmt, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT) as maxPerTenderAmt,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN, RELEASE_INFO.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN) as minTenderPxForPlan, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN) as maxTenderPxForPlan, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_STEP, RELEASE_INFO.TENDER_STEP) as tenderStep,
nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED, RELEASE_INFO.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED) as medianMaxBidMarked, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER) as maxTenderPxDiffer, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT, RELEASE_INFO.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT) as continuousTenderLimit, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT * 100000000, RELEASE_INFO.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT) as maxTotalTenderAmt
FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO SEC_INFO --wind一级未发行债券信息接口表 LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO RELEASE_INFO ON SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = RELEASE_INFO.SEC_ID --wind一级未发行债券发行信息接口表 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO where SECURITY_TYPE in('CD','14')) RDI_RELEASE_INFO ON RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SECURITY_ID = SEC_INFO.SEC_ID --银行间债券再发行信息接口表
SEC_INFO.VALUE_DATE < to_date(#{platformDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND rownum = 1
AND SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION = #{secName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID SECID, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbreviation, PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME bondName, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET tradingPlaces, PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG registeredCustodian, PRODUCT.ISSUER, PRODUCT.ISSUE_TYPE issueType, PRODUCT.VDATE valueDate, PRODUCT.MDATE expiryDate, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_9 primaryClassification, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_10 secondaryClassification, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_11 threearyClassification, PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES varietyOfCoupons, ISSUE.INT_TYPE interestRate, ISSUE.PAY_CYCLE interestPaymentFrequency, PRODUCT.CCY currency, PRODUCT.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, PRODUCT_ADD.IS_AUTO_UPDATE isAutoUpdate, ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS issueMethod, ISSUE.TENDER_TYPE biddingMethod, ISSUE.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, ISSUE.PLAN_ISSUE_AMT issueSize, ISSUE.ISSUE_STYLE releaseType, ISSUE.ADD_BATCH additionalBatches, ISSUE.ISSUE_PRICE issuePx, ISSUE.REFER_YIELD stipulationValue, ISSUE.REFER_YIELD couponRate, ISSUE.RATE_GRADE benchmarkCurveName, ISSUE.RATE_GRADE decimalPlaces, ISSUE.BP spread, ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE issueDate, ISSUE.PAY_DATE payDate, ISSUE.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE interestAccrualDate, ISSUE.ISSUE_SDATE issueStartTime, ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE issueEndTime, ISSUE.TENDER_SDATE bidDate, ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE additionalTenderDate, ISSUE.PAY_EDATE eventDate, ISSUE.ASSIGN_REGDATE debtRegistrationDate, PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE listingDate, PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID listingCode, ISSUE.MIN_PAMT singleMinSubAmt, ISSUE.MAX_PAMT singleMaxSubAmt, ISSUE.MAX_TOTALAMT maxSubAmt, ISSUE.MIN_PER_TAMT minPerTenderAmt, ISSUE.MAX_PER_UTAMT maxPerTenderAmt, ISSUE.MIN_TAMT minTenderPxForPlan, ISSUE.MAX_TAMT maxTenderPxForPlan, ISSUE.TENDER_UNIT tenderStep, ISSUE.MAX_TENDER_UNIT medianMaxBidMarked, ISSUE.MAX_TENDER_PLUS maxTenderPxDiffer, ISSUE.SERI_Y_N continuousTenderLimit, ISSUE.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER maxTotalTenderAmt, PRODUCT.DELISTING_DATE delistingDate, PRODUCT.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID AND PRODUCT_TYPE.BRANCH = 0 where PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET in ('01','02') AND (PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND rownum = 1
